title: Normal Attack
text: “Air Stab!”
“Second Arrow!”
Looking at Ren and Itsuki, they don’t seem to be using very powerful skills. Well, back then, they only had skills of moderate strength, after all.
“Gaaaaaaaaaaah!”

Ren, Itsuki, and the others are putting up a good fight against the Dimensional Chimera. It looks like they’re dealing less damage than I remember. Well, since the three of them took it on together, maybe the battle was over quickly? It’s not exactly a powerful monster, so that’s certainly possible.
“You’re finally here! Motoyasu, what have you been doing?”
Ren said that to me as I rushed over, dodging the Chimera’s attacks.
“Weren’t you just slacking off, anyway?”
“I was directing the evacuation. There’s a village nearby, after all—don’t Ren and Itsuki realize we have to minimize the damage?”
“Hmph. We should just leave that to the folks at the castle.”
“Yes, our goal is to quell the unrest as quickly as possible. We might as well leave that to Naofumi, who can’t even fight.”

Did he really say that? He sure has the nerve to say that without giving a second thought to how hard the Father is working. Do Ren and Itsuki even understand that the Knights rained down a storm of fire on the Father, who was protecting everyone?
“Please stop badmouthing the Father. He may not be able to attack, but he can stop the enemy’s movements and make it easier for us to fight.”
That’s right. When facing a chimera like this time, how do you think Father would move? I’m picturing in my head exactly how he’d handle it.

First, he’d probably grab the chimera around its front legs to stop its movement. Next, using his shield—which has counterattack capabilities—he’d gradually inflict status ailments on the enemy, wouldn’t he? After that, he’d rely on me, Big Sister, and our other allies to deliver the finishing blow.

Yeah. Just doing that would let me, Big Sister, and our other allies focus entirely on attacking without having to split our attention to dodge. Do you think they realize just how much of a difference this makes in efficiency…? I’m sure they don’t understand it at all.
“Besides, if it’s just Ren and Itsuki, the village will be destroyed.”
“We just need to defeat the boss before that happens!”
“Since they’ll keep spawning endlessly unless we defeat the boss, we’ll have to put up with a minimum amount of damage!”
“Hmph… This is exactly why Ren and Itsuki are…”

For a hero not to save lives, but to choose which lives to save… that’s the height of arrogance. I made a promise to my Father and to Filo-tan. To be sincere, kind to everyone, and to achieve true peace.
No matter how much I suffer, I will save every life that can be saved. That is the promise I made to my Father and Filo-tan. Fighting for my own pleasure is absolutely out of the question!
“What did you say?”
“If you have a problem with that, just say so!”
“It’s nothing. It’s pointless to even say anything.”

Anyway, the top priority right now is to defeat the chimera as quickly as possible. However, if it becomes obvious that we’re far stronger than the Itsuki group, our knowledge of the future will be useless. So let’s go without using any Skills this time. I hold up my index finger to Yuki-chan and the others, signaling them to go easy on it.
“Gaaaah!”

A lion’s roar thunders, and the snake on the chimera’s tail locks onto its target. With a whoosh, the dragon’s head breathes fire, and the goat’s head swings its horns. I don’t use any Skills myself; I just stab at it repeatedly with normal attacks. With each strike, I pierce the Chimera’s fur and shatter its bones, and I can see it visibly weakening.
“Motoyasu! Give it your all! Use your Skills…”
“If you’re just here to play around, please go home…”

Ren and Itsuki’s voices trailed off mid-sentence. Even though these are just normal attacks, they’re far stronger than anything Ren or Itsuki can currently pull off. They’re probably speechless at the sheer power.
“Ah, so you used that skill—the one where you gain immense Attack Power in exchange for being unable to use other Skills!”
“I see! That explains it!”
Are they talking about Berserker? Unfortunately, I’m not using it. Well, I’ll admit that such a skill exists. But considering the efficiency and how the skill works, it just isn’t worth it.
My Attack Power is far too high compared to Ren and Itsuki’s. In fact, I’m holding back quite a bit, and I’m still this strong. To mistake that for a skill… what a complete clown.
Even if I told them how I’m boosting my Attack Power, they wouldn’t believe me anyway. To Ren and Itsuki right now, a normal attack probably looks like a skill.
That wasn’t a Skill. It was just a thrust. That’s right!
Eventually, the chimera couldn’t withstand my attacks any longer and collapsed with a thud. Without missing a beat, I thrust my spear into the crack in the wave, instantly sealing it shut.
“Well, that’s about it, I guess.”
“Yeah. This boss was a piece of cake.”
“Right. At this rate, the next wave will be a breeze, too.”
“The only ones thinking that are Ren and Itsuki.”
“…What’s with you lately?!”
“If you have something to say, just say it clearly!”
Whoa, I got scolded. I was just warning the two of them that they’d get blown away in the next wave. Well, no need to worry about it.
“Alright, time for the loot!”

Well then, I’ve already got a gift for my Father. At that moment, I cut off the lion’s head—the part that seemed most likely to boost my Attack Power—and attached it to my weapon. A dragon’s head would’ve been fine too, but Ren stubbornly insisted on it, so I let him have it. Itsuki, acting all knowledgeable, wanted the goat’s head. I remember we just skinned the rest of the body haphazardly.
“Alright, let’s divide the spoils. I’ll take the lion’s head and the snake from its tail.”
“Hey! Don’t just decide that on your own!”
“Well, would you prefer a different part? If you’ll give me the dragon’s head, I’d be happy with that too.”
“No, that’s…”
Ren has his sights set on the dragon’s head, after all. If I say this, he’ll back down. This is the moment when my knowledge of the future comes in handy.
“Why are you trying to take the best parts first, Motoyasu-san?!”
“I landed the first hit, you know!”
“I think I deserve the MVP, don’t you?”
The chimera weakened right before my eyes thanks to my thrusts. That’s an undeniable fact.
“Besides, thanks to Father, the village was saved, so I’m taking my share.”
“Wait a minute—Naofumi, you were just protecting the villagers, weren’t you?”
“Ren and Itsuki, who can only charge in like wild boars, couldn’t have protected the village on their own.”
“What did you say?!”
“Actually, by the time the Knights arrived, the evacuation was almost complete. If it weren’t for Father, that village would’ve already been wiped out.”
“What?”
“Besides, the Knights were the ones who rained fire down on Father, his companions, and us in the first place.”
“…Is that really true?”
When I nodded, Ren’s expression—which had been one of displeasure just moments before—shifted to one of deep thought. After a moment, Ren spoke in a calm voice.
“Well, the tail isn’t exactly prime material anyway. And seeing how Motoyasu did… Fine.”
With that, Ren seemed to have compromised. In stark contrast, however, Itsuki’s face turned bright red as he lashed out at me.
“There’s no way the kingdom would do something like that! Don’t go spouting nonsense!”

“Either way, Naofumi should get some of the materials too, right?　After all, it was Naofumi and Motoyasu who protected the village. That probably saved some people’s lives. Or do you want to keep it all for yourself, Itsuki?”
“Ugh… Fine. But there’s a part I want, so I’ll let you have it.”
“Well then, I’ll take it! Haah!”
I dashingly thrust my spear into the neck of the chimera’s lion’s head and sliced it clean off, then secured the snake’s tail in the same way.
“Alright then, Yuki-chan and Kou. I’m off to deliver the lion’s head to my Father!”
“Yes, ma’am!”
“Yes! Let’s go, let’s go!”

I attached the snake tail to my spear, and a new weapon called the “Chimera Viper Spear” was added to my inventory. It seems to be a spear with a poison effect. Its stats aren’t as bad as I expected, but I don’t need it right now. I’ll unlock it later.
“W-wow, that was fast…”
“He cut off the head with a single thrust!?”
Ren is talking to Itsuki while glancing back and forth between his own sword and me as I walk away. Right now, delivering the materials to my Father is the top priority.
“Alright! Let’s go!”

And just like that, our first wave ended without a hitch. My father is taking out the remaining monsters from the wave alongside Sakura-chan, Keel, and the Lazy Pig. It looks like the Knights are still in the thick of battle, too. I think the annihilation of the monsters will be over soon.
“Father, here’s a souvenir.”
“Ah, you took it down? This will make the fight easier… right? Wait, it’s huge! A giant lion’s head?”
“It’s a chimera’s head. Here, Father, please mount it on your shield.”
“U-uh, yeah. Thanks, Motoyasu-kun.”
Father mounted the lion’s head—which Yuki-chan and the others had carried over—onto his shield. With this, I think Father will unlock a reasonably good shield.
“Ah, this… it looks like I’ll need to unlock multiple shields made from chimera materials first.”
“I brought some of those materials with me as well.”
“Thank you for everything. What about you, Motoyasu-kun?”
“I’ve already unlocked mine, so it’s no problem.”
Now Father and I have matching gear. Was it the Chimera Lion Spear? I remember it was a reasonably good spear. Well, there’s a big difference in Attack Power compared to my current spear, though.
